Version 17.0.0 of social-creative-builder introduces a major contract and data handling update.

- All projections now read from canonical narrative, claims, and channels (not raw memory trees).
- Output must include the narrative/claims dependency tuple and claims projection offset, with new dependency-status tags (verified, approved-fallback, blocked).
- Scope section now clarifies event-proposal/write behavior: all unresolved claims or channel facts generate authorized propose events; this skill never mutates canonical projections.
- File structure streamlined: legacy support docs removed.
- Instructions and data source details updated to reflect new canonical read paths.

- Major update: Expanded skill instructions, detailed contract, stricter scope guard, and clarified claims handling.
- Now generates ready-to-paste, platform-native social content packages or carousel specs per user idea and chosen channels, following platform norm cards and voice card guidance.
- Every variant is tagged with formula, hook family, CTA type, and signal optimization; all claims must match ledger wording or are flagged for source.
- Includes explicit limitations: does not post, schedule, audit, brief, or repurpose existing content—those are handled by other skills.
- Stronger compliance for Chinese platforms; increased transparency on automation boundaries and approval requirements.
- Enhanced handoff summary and memory/write-back procedures to streamline downstream review and publication.
